extraction.Name: Joseph Tapio
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his 480 acre allotment at the time he got it, September 29,1919, but was informed that, it would be taxed anyway,if he did not take, and finally sold for taxes, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his allotment—not wishing to pay the taxes—to Dari Ulrichs, of Kadoka, South Dakota, for $8000.00, receiving about $2000.00 in cash, and $4000.00 in trade, consisting of horses and mules
extraction.Buyer: Dari Ulrichs of Kadoka, South Dakota for $8000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: sold his allotment—not wishing to pay the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: contracts for buildings, which is his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has a wife who has poor health, and one minor child who has good health to support; considers it a poor price for his land; Mr. Ulrichs finished paying the $2000.00 cash; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; affidavit sworn December 3, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
